Entries.SourceTerm: 努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃

Senses.PreferredTarget: Work to settle it in this life; do not leave yourself to suffering for endless ages.
SearchAliases: Work to settle it in this life; do not leave yourself to suffering for endless ages
Senses.Note: The warning turns urgency about birth and death into present practice. It is an exhortation, not a prediction of any named person's fate.

Occurrences.Kwic: 惺去，如世良馬見鞭影而行；其或未然，黃帝遺玄珠于赤水，使知索之而不得，使離朱索之而不得，使喫詬索之而不得，乃使象罔，象罔得之。黃帝曰：『異哉！象罔乃得此珠！』玄珠既得，且道在甚麼處？」乃示獻珠勢云：「連城難比況，照乘未為明，不惜當陽示，同教受用親。或有當面蹉過，山僧不免更演第二齣說白一上。今日七月十九，乃是山僧從母胎出生的時節，年年逢此時節，山僧也不管生與不生，只恁麼過。今年逢此時節，不覺一則以喜，一則以懼。所喜者何？記得去年上天童，兵戈忽起，江關阻隔，每憶此方道侶，恐此生不得相聚。今幸重新會晤，歡笑如昨，出於意外，是一喜也。又前年饑荒，我諸弟子同此忍餒修行，是後住山住水，或東或西。今聞山僧遠遠歸來，各各來集，所謂從我於陳蔡者，今得及門，又一喜也。所懼者何？懼古人道：『人生不滿百。』今年生日添了一歲，須知將來已減了一歲，生死無常，豈得不懼？然此一懼，現前緇緇素素皆該有底。何故？既同生在世間，定各有箇生日遇著，生日添了一歲，將來亦各少了一歲。設若大事未明，日用隨著二境轉，順則多喜、逆則多憂，自古世間，稱意事常少，不稱意事常多，未免憂多喜少，隨境漂流，於苦海中頭出頭沒，何時能了？所以道：『努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃。』先聖見我輩從無始以來，受生受死，莫可算數。所謂積骨如毘富羅山，飲乳如四大海水，今生又復茫然而過，未來生死冥然無涯，可不哀耶？然則要了生死，別無門路，須悟無生。不見當時王摩詰是箇詩人，卻曉得此意，作詩云：『獨坐悲雙鬢，空堂欲二更，雨中山果落，燈下草蟲鳴。白髮終難變，黃金不可成，欲知除老病，惟有學無生。』永嘉云：『幾回生，幾回死，生死悠悠無定止。自從頓悟了無生，于諸榮辱何憂喜？』西方偈云：『願生西方淨土中，上品蓮花為父母。花開見佛悟無生，不退菩薩為伴侶。』今人多說參禪要悟，念佛不消悟。據此偈，何常不要悟來？須知要了生死須了無生，要了無生須有箇悟門，不論參禪念佛。今或不了其中旨趣，自己執定是東方人，世界是穢濁底，佛決定在西方，世界是淨底。殊不知此偈正治你此執病，意謂你不必執娑婆定是穢濁惡世，全身染著在裡許，你當願生西方淨土中，意謂願生淨土，淨土便現前。何故？法無定相，隨心而轉。譬如人尋常做得件好事，面前本無有佛，忽見佛現。或菩薩現、蓮花現。忽若做得一件不好事，自心不安，面前忽見地獄相、怖畏相諸惡境界。豈不是善惡之境原無定在，皆從想念而出？你若離諸執著，只此娑婆世界坑坎堆阜，便是極樂世界地

Occurrences.Kwic: 得破，善入戒體，去來本自在，真心任遍知。其或未然，古人道：『著相持戒生天福，猶如仰箭射虛空。勢力盡，箭還墜，招得來生不如意。爭似無為實相門，一超直入如來地。』有等外道聞恁麼說，他也道無為無為。末法當代，去聖時遙，如粵地天邊之所，無智人辨別，竟遞相聾瞽，瞎人眼目。又扯無為，無所不為，便縱行婬怒癡，廣肆殺害，亦曰無妨。罪過罪過。如山僧不涉世諦，遠離塵囂，心中亦無遠離之念，信口道來，不假思議，自然恰好。從朝至暮，覓絲毫生相不可得，覓絲毫滅相不可得，將不可得又不可得，又不妨應用于千差，此名無為，無所不為。山僧為諸人說破，當捨妄歸真。皈依佛。佛者，自性之覺體；皈依法，法者，一念心清淨。皈依僧，僧者，即自性之真體也。如此自心受持，不涉外緣，即不皈依邪魔外道。外道者，心外有法，名為外道。或見光見花、見佛、見菩薩、幢幡、寶蓋、童子來迎，俱是外道、魔王眷屬。在正教觀來，趁出法海邊外，永不聞佛法之名。何故？謗大般若。畢竟如何即是？我要你正不許邪，要你是不許非，要你上不許下。前有僧問山僧：『如何是向上事？』山僧向他道：『但莫向下。』語既如然，事事如然。大眾！粵地法道無聞，善知識難遇，當生慶幸，不可空過時光。努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃。」下座。解制普說。師云：「龍牙道：『天下名山到因腳，辛苦多年與襪著。而今老大不能行，手裡把柄破木杓。』又五祖演道：『腳也不能著草鞋，手也不能把木杓，端坐受供養，施主常安樂。』又千巖常云：『盡大地是隻破草鞋，盡大地是個破木杓。要把便把，要著便著，佛祖何曾摸得著？』山僧則不然，到晚歸單長伸腳，爬下眠床便著襪，日食三餐即便休，沒有工夫去摸索。向摸索時，摸到無可摸，開眼也著；無可摸處再摸索，合眼也著。正謂時逢末運，山僧以不欺之心為諸人點破。今時參禪人，認著昭昭靈靈為主人公，縱有省悟處，悟跡猶存，己見尚在，騎個驢兒不肯下，不道不是，怎奈矮子泥壁，不肯虛心親覲明眼師家煆煉見地，不辯青黃性理，一味儱侗，自瞞瞞人、自欺欺人，正是一盲引眾盲。不特今人如是，即古亦如然。石霜禪師有泰首座請益，霜云：『一條白練去，古廟香爐去、冷湫湫的去、一念萬年去。』古人素樸，得師一語，便恁麼二十年。後石霜圓寂，眾擬請首座居方丈位。時九峰為侍者，乃曰：『會得先師意，某亦執侍。』遂問曰：『餘俱不問，秪如先師道：一條白練去，作麼生會？』泰云：『此明一色邊事。』峰不肯。泰云：『不肯某那？』峰曰：『是。』泰云：『裝香來。』香煙起處

Occurrences.Kwic: 間，管教時刻寸香了當無疑。若不恁麼真參，云何得到歸家田地？假饒弄到臨末稍頭，依舊一場懡㦬，莫怪山僧不道。」開示。師云：「人命無常呼吸間，大家著力奮精參，了明生死玄關外，免被閆家老熱瞞。山僧恁麼告報，秪為諸禪各懷特達向上之志，紹隆佛祖之心，豈可不為保任此事？但要諸人痛切生死急務，自然二六時中頭頭法法本分相應。若也參情親切，心心無間，步步不離，管取三七日內如人飲水，冷煖自知。苟或伶俐道人，纔聞一撥便轉，猶是落二落三了也。倘依俙彷彿，還須咬定牙關，急著眼看，看到水窮山盡處，方知格外有通衢。心隨萬境轉，轉處實能幽，隨流認得性，無喜亦無憂。珍重。」開示。目顧左右云：「若向者裏會得，各請歸堂穩坐；苟或未然，只可把定繩頭、咬定牙關、豎起脊梁，將生死二字貼在額頭上，看定本參，不分星夜，毫釐勿使走作，直下聖凡情見、是非人我一齊坐斷，不覺有世界身心都盧是個疑團，管取到家決不遠矣。倘若隨群作隊，三三兩兩雜話閒談，今日如此、明日如彼，更或觸境逢源，無明煩惱、我慢貢高，自逞伶俐聰明，處處是非滾滾、頭頭業識忙忙，恁麼學道，不唯不了己躬大事，亦且辜負檀信脂膏、行人血汗，猶恐大限到來依舊一場懡㦬。既然如是，合作麼生？努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃。」憨予暹禪師語錄卷第三憨予暹禪師語錄卷第四嗣法門人法雲廣學仝編機緣機緣鶚力長老參，云：「有一問，請和尚決疑可否？」師云：「未入門早與三十棒了也。」進云：「意旨如何？」師云：「不識痛癢漢。」僧喝，師便打，僧擬議，師云：「將謂南方舶主。」僧繞師一匝，師云：「降將不斬。」僧拂袖而出，師云：「草賊大敗。」僧參，師問：「發足何方？」僧云：「南方。」師舉拂子云：「南方有者箇麼？」僧云：「和尚曾到過。」師云：「向在那裏住？」僧云：「天童。」師云：「昨夜小白嶺走到太白峰，鼻孔裏七佛塔呵呵大笑，且道笑箇甚麼？」僧無語，師便打。大苑馬二酉宋居士問：「西來大意即且止，如何是本來面目？」師云：「問從何來？」士擬議，師云：「瞻之在前，忽焉在後。」士云：「多年閱藏，未遇宗乘。」師舉茶，云：「會麼？」士無語，師云：「一大藏教總在裏許。」寰座主問：「即今天童和尚在甚麼處？」師震威一喝。主云：「窠臼語。」師云：「韓盧逐塊。」西天羅漢參，問云：「如何是佛法大意？」師豎一指，漢亦豎一指，師於桌上書卍字，漢向前抹卻，師打○相，漢無語，師云：「將謂西天來，梵字也不識。」禹錫劉都憲問：「宗門多用棒喝，是何意旨？」師云：「殺人刀

Occurrences.Kwic: ？」師云：「眉毛隙裏贏三際。」進云：「涅槃本自無生滅，生死還同夢裏遊，且道誰向誰背？」師云：「牡丹花下睡貓兒。」乃云：「來若昇日，去如脫屣，備諸踊沒，恆沙杳矣。淑氣華妍，埃塵不起，妙法咸聞，鉗鎚高舉。」以杖指靈座云：「九十翁挺慧悟于曠劫，體妙解于當年，屈此無為，眇塵劫之初，寂照所通，該六和之外，諮諏往事，觀矚方來，鑽扣禪機，令人結舌，所利為人，所約為己，其跡同形，其源莫測，皆是本習所懷。只如清淨于一切法，還有涅槃生死也無？覿體純真須抖擻，翻身擲抹太虛空。」授法嗣，上堂。豎拄杖，云：「漁臺山上把竿，清龍河裏釣鱉，落湛一天星斗，數來何日休歇？山河大地盡作獅子哮吼，艸木叢林自然家邦安貼，負汝負吾之機，何異鍼頭削銕？分明據令提綱，不似止啼黃葉。」卓拄丈，云：「幸爾釣得南斗六、北斗七歸來，且貴大家暖熱。」喝一喝。中元，闔姓薦資，請上堂。「不輟殷殷求薦拔，生死戶門八字開，處處澹紅黃葉墜，山山擁起白雲堆。大眾！滿眼滿耳以為當仁剖露，寢興變化未嘗暫歇，皆生死也。空裏眼花、日中身影，妄想滅消、見聞執謝，只于無量劫中生死根本廣而窺之，皆是染緣覺性中之輪轉，動念積為之所籠罩，于此不昧見聞，脫然超悟。所以云：努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃。」遂抗聲云：「大眾！」眾抬首，師云：「撇開情世，咫尺家山。」擲杖，下座。上堂。「金針密處，玉線潛通。異彩雲羅，難藏拙巧。春風一段，理事渾融。自顯真機，逐意徒逞。且道梭頭在誰手裏？」卓拄丈曰：「藝高不在乖名聞，兀然方見把機人。」喝一喝。小參。「眉毛剔起，寶劍拈來，一切截斷，豈不快哉？大眾！山僧恁麼說話，還有不避鋒威者麼？」左右盻云：「要敵生死之關鍵，須是本色衲子始得。」卓拄丈曰：「且道放行好？把住好？古鏡不磨含萬象，猶勝當年面壁翁。」般若野月和尚入塔，請上堂。問：「天地同根，根蒂幽固，還假覷向也無？」師云：「妙機不謂咸狼藉。」進云：「萬物一體，體相虛凝，還同證據也無？」師云：「報本還從達帝畿。」進云：「即今薦拔筵開，當陽顯現，猶是報答耶？證據耶？」師云：「一道光明匝地天。」進云：「遐邇緇流，雍雍肅肅，未諳誰是承當者？」師云：「腳跟下痛領一頓。」進云：「恁麼報恩已竟，撥轉關頭去也。」師云：「腦後依然欠一椎。」乃云：「敗葉露枝條，大地冰霜結，一線得挨開，英風動漻泬。藕絲牽象入孔中，挨落珊瑚枝杪月，驚起清風河北神，乾闥王失安生穴。到者裏，還有涅槃可證麼？還有煩惱可除麼？還有生死可了麼？總或不

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 得破，善入戒體，去來本自在，真心任遍知。其或未然，古人道：『著相持戒生天福，猶如仰箭射虛空。勢力盡，箭還墜，招得來生不如意。爭似無為實相門，一超直入如來地。』有等外道聞恁麼說，他也道無為無為。末法當代，去聖時遙，如粵地天邊之所，無智人辨別，竟遞相聾瞽，瞎人眼目。又扯無為，無所不為，便縱行婬怒癡，廣肆殺害，亦曰無妨。罪過罪過。如山僧不涉世諦，遠離塵囂，心中亦無遠離之念，信口道來，不假思議，自然恰好。從朝至暮，覓絲毫生相不可得，覓絲毫滅相不可得，將不可得又不可得，又不妨應用于千差，此名無為，無所不為。山僧為諸人說破，當捨妄歸真。皈依佛。佛者，自性之覺體；皈依法，法者，一念心清淨。皈依僧，僧者，即自性之真體也。如此自心受持，不涉外緣，即不皈依邪魔外道。外道者，心外有法，名為外道。或見光見花、見佛、見菩薩、幢幡、寶蓋、童子來迎，俱是外道、魔王眷屬。在正教觀來，趁出法海邊外，永不聞佛法之名。何故？謗大般若。畢竟如何即是？我要你正不許邪，要你是不許非，要你上不許下。前有僧問山僧：『如何是向上事？』山僧向他道：『但莫向下。』語既如然，事事如然。大眾！粵地法道無聞，善知識難遇，當生慶幸，不可空過時光。努力今生須了卻，莫教永劫受餘殃。」下座。解制普說。師云：「龍牙道：『天下名山到因腳，辛苦多年與襪著。而今老大不能行，手裡把柄破木杓。』又五祖演道：『腳也不能著草鞋，手也不能把木杓，端坐受供養，施主常安樂。』又千巖常云：『盡大地是隻破草鞋，盡大地是個破木杓。要把便把，要著便著，佛祖何曾摸得著？』山僧則不然，到晚歸單長伸腳，爬下眠床便著襪，日食三餐即便休，沒有工夫去摸索。向摸索時，摸到無可摸，開眼也著；無可摸處再摸索，合眼也著。正謂時逢末運，山僧以不欺之心為諸人點破。今時參禪人，認著昭昭靈靈為主人公，縱有省悟處，悟跡猶存，己見尚在，騎個驢兒不肯下，不道不是，怎奈矮子泥壁，不肯虛心親覲明眼師家煆煉見地，不辯青黃性理，一味儱侗，自瞞瞞人、自欺欺人，正是一盲引眾盲。不特今人如是，即古亦如然。石霜禪師有泰首座請益，霜云：『一條白練去，古廟香爐去、冷湫湫的去、一念萬年去。』古人素樸，得師一語，便恁麼二十年。後石霜圓寂，眾擬請首座居方丈位。時九峰為侍者，乃曰：『會得先師意，某亦執侍。』遂問曰：『餘俱不問，秪如先師道：一條白練去，作麼生會？』泰云：『此明一色邊事。』峰不肯。泰云：『不肯某那？』峰曰：『是。』泰云：『裝香來。』香煙起處

Senses.Explanation: Work to settle it in this life; do not leave yourself to suffering for endless ages. The warning turns urgency about birth and death into present practice. Current source uses: Muyun in J26nB184, Daxiu Zhu in J27nB192, Hanyu Xian in J33nB288, Foyuan in J37nB371. The full turn controls the meaning. It is an exhortation, not a prediction of any named person's fate.

Senses.PreferredTarget: it would cost me my descendants
AlternateTargets: it would ruin my lineage heirs
Senses.Note: One lineage-warning sense, attested in two Tier-1 authored works and one Tier-2 discourse. All three transmit the same Huangbo–Baizhang case and are not presented as three independent events. The lamp parallel is unnecessary.

ClaimAnchors.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record (碧巖錄): Yuanwu transmits and comments on the case, but Huangbo is the exact speaker of the headword-bearing warning.

Senses.Explanation: Huangbo says that if he were counted as Mazu's direct successor, it would 'cost me my descendants.' The concern is lineage transmission: an inadequate or merely equal view diminishes what later heirs receive. Baizhang's answer supplies the case's criterion—seeing level with the teacher reduces the teacher's virtue by half, while seeing beyond the teacher is fit for transmission. The three retained texts corroborate the wording and interpretation but transmit one inherited case, not three separate semantic uses.

Senses.Explanation: To lose body and life is a forceful verdict of total loss or mortal peril. Boshan Wuyi warns that analytical sorting of old cases scarcely avoids it, while Yuanwu Keqin compares deliberation before a vajra sword to the same loss. Baofu Congzhan says that grasping or failing to grasp the matter does not avoid it; Linji Yixuan instead says that acting for the teaching does not shrink from it. Xiangyan Zhixian’s tree case gives the phrase its sharpest dilemma: answering is fatal, but silence fails the question.

Senses.PreferredTarget: You lose body and life without even knowing it

Senses.Note: The phrase marks a loss one can suffer while thinking the exchange is going well. Yinyuan says it after a monk declares that he has turned around; Yichu offers it as the response to someone asking to meet him before the sword is drawn. Lianyue says it when asked where the first meaning lies. Yunwai uses it in answer to the entry shout, and Pinjixiang says it when a monk denies being thrown into the river. Each use joins peril to failure to recognize it.

Senses.Explanation: The warning adds a sharper turn to the familiar image of losing body and life: the one at risk does not even notice. Yinyuan, Yichu, and Lianyue aim the phrase at a claimed turn, an encounter with the master, and a search for the first meaning. Yunwai uses it to check the entry shout, while Pinjixiang applies it to a monk’s confident denial.

Senses.Explanation: Su Shi's stream-sound line is repeatedly raised as a claim that the landscape voices teaching, then praised, tested, or sharply criticized. The master the record spells 古卓 raises Dongpo's awakening verse; the verse assigns the headword to Su Shi, while Feiyin is only the biography subject. An anonymous layman quotes Dongpo's paired lines and Yunwai answers by prescribing thirty blows. Chulin Shangrui directly repeats the line before rejecting it as chasing external objects. Wanfeng Shiwei directly raises the old line and says it remains trapped in sound and form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫，不顧危亡，拌著性命，自肯單刀直入，管教坐享成功。倘或三撻不回，一任東西南北。何故？十方薄伽梵，一路涅槃門，把手牽伊行不得，為人自肯乃方親。」喝一喝。圓通大士誕辰，上堂。「返耳觀心，耳中著水。返眼聽性，眼裏撒沙。所返既忘，觀聽亦寂。動靜二相，了然不生。二相不生，生滅自滅。生滅既滅，寂滅見前。心境一如，是真三昧。」乃豎拂子，云：「大眾見麼？」擊禪床，云：「聞麼？觀世音菩薩從此聞修三昧，安詳而起，向山僧拂子頭上示見百億香水海、百億須彌山、百億佛國土、百億眾生界。於諸界中復見百億大自在身、百億爍迦羅首、百億母陀羅臂、百億清淨寶目，復放百億大寶光明，交光相羅如寶絲網。於諸光中復出百億廣長舌相，一時出大梵音道：『淨法界身，本無出沒。大悲願力，示見受生。和光同塵，應機接物。從無住本，流出萬端。』於是應以國王、宰官、居士、長者、天龍八部、人非人等，乃至佛身得度者，即皆見之而為說法。如天普蓋，似地普擎。統三界以為家，作四生之依怙。生凡育聖，廣利群品。有感必通，無求不應。大眾！既然菩薩見如是種種神變、作如是種種佛事，可謂殊勝中殊勝、奇特中奇特。正當恁麼時節，畢竟如何瞻仰？」乃起身，以拂子拂一拂，云：「溪聲盡是廣長舌，山色無非清淨身。」師誕辰，上堂。問：「四月八日佛降誕，二月廿一祖師生，且道是同？是別？」師云：「一箇鼻頭，兩孔出氣。」進云：「昔日道：『惟吾獨尊。』今日道甚麼？」師便打。進云：「畢竟如何是為人的的句？」師復打，乃云：「山僧適來在方丈內有一句子佛法，擬欲拈出供養眾兄弟，卻被木上座一口吞卻了也。如今更要別尋兩句以悉鄙衷，只是一期又說不盡。何故？向下文長。」上堂。「七尺蘆柴直下鉤，斷橋水上截西流，漁翁既不藏徼倖，果是金鱗快聚頭。」以拄杖作釣勢，云：「眾中莫有金鱗麼？」一僧出，師云：「不是，不是。」進云：「是，是。」師云：「是箇什麼？」僧擬議，師打云：「是甚鍼眼魚，來上龍門釣？」時數僧問答皆不契，師下座，一齊打散，拽杖歸方丈。上堂。「古人道：『若立一塵，家國興盛，野老顰蹙；不立一塵，家國喪亡，野老安帖。』山僧三十年前傾倉罄橐，祇得箇窮唇寡舌、雪骨冰肌，即今雖住箇院子，與眾兄弟說話，窮也不得、富也不得，有也不得、無也不得。何故？若富貴，則眾星飛彗，未免雙月同宮；若貧窮，雖四海宴清，要且孤君即位。大眾且道：『有無雙遣、富貧不立一句作麼生道？』」拈拄杖，卓一卓，喝一喝，云：「大士淨缾陳瓦子，彌勒布袋破葫蘆。」上堂

Occurrences.Kwic: 消遣？又有般底，祇向佛邊會，却與自己沒交涉。古人道：凡有言句，須是一一消歸自己。又作麼生？又有般底，一向祇作自己會，棄却古人用處，唯知道明自己事。古人方便，却如何消遣？既消遣不下，却似抱橋柱澡洗，要且放手不得。此亦是一病。又有般底，却去脚多少處會？若恁麼會，此病最難醫也。所以他語有巧妙處，參學人卒難摸索，纔擬心則差了也。前輩謂之楊岐宗旨，須是他屋裏人到恁麼田地方堪傳授。若不然者，則守定枯樁之謂也。這公案直須還他透頂徹底漢方能了得。此非止禪和子會不得，而今天下叢林中出世為人底亦少有會得者。若要會去，直須向威音那畔、空劫已前輕輕覰著，提起便行、捺著便轉，却向萬仞峰前進一步，可以籠󰋪古今，坐斷天下人舌頭。如今還有恁麼者麼？有則出來道看。如無，更聽一頌：三脚驢子弄蹄行，直透威音萬丈坑。雲在嶺頭閒不徹，水流㵎下太忙生。湖南長老誰解會？行人更在青山外。上堂：天得一以清，地得一以寧，君王得一以治天下。這箇說語是家常茶飯，須知衲僧家別有奇特處始得。且道衲僧門下有甚奇特處？天得一，斗牛女虗危

Senses.Explanation: A 禪堂 is the Zen hall, a concrete room in a monastery. Yongjue Yuanxian speaks at the completion of a newly built hall; Micang Kai's posthumous writings preserve regulations for one; Jiexian places admission to it before entering the teacher's room; and Guxue Zhe contrasts walking around its pillar with eating in the refectory and sitting on a cushion.

Senses.Explanation: A Chan visitor is a monastic participant addressed or identified within the public life of a named master’s community. Linji points the hall toward two such visitors after their exchange; Foyin interprets visitors' bows before the assembly; Dazhu addresses arriving students by the title; Nanyang examines one from the south; and Yanguan challenges the visitors to supply a turning phrase. Verse writers also address this audience. The term therefore marks an active interview participant or visiting student, not simply any traveler.

Entries.SourceTerm: 禪客相逢只彈指，此心能有幾人知

Senses.PreferredTarget: When Chan travelers meet, they need only snap their fingers; how many people know this mind?
AlternateTargets: Chan visitors meet with a finger snap; few know the mind it points to
SearchAliases: Chan travelers meet finger snap who knows mind
Senses.Note: Two Chan travelers meet and communicate with a snap of the fingers; the second line asks who knows the mind at issue. Jinian and Yuanjie use the pair after discussing recognition. Yuejiang and Liaoan use it after describing ordinary direct action and present response. An older Guanxiu poem is part of its family, but these four masters give the pair current work.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 地、草木叢林、城邑聚落、人畜草木，皆與實相不相違背。末後復作幻虎，還食幻師。幻師既滅，諸幻隨滅；諸幻既滅，幻滅亦滅。良久，拍禪牀云：雙林樹下少人行，多子塔前閙如市。上堂，舉：僧問洞山：如何是古佛心？山云：巢知風，穴知雨。師頌云：巢知風，穴知雨，一句明明為君舉。森羅萬象盡交參，渤海新羅齊鼓舞。報諸人，休莽鹵，古德有言兮，先天為心祖。結制，上堂。僧問：有句無句，如藤倚樹，此意如何？師云：無齒大虫當路坐。進云：疎山問：忽若樹倒藤枯，句歸何處？溈山呵呵大笑又作麼生？師云：曹娥讀夜󳬴。進云：後來明招為佗點破，還端的也無？師云：臨厓看滸眼，特地一場愁。進云：今日學人問和尚：樹倒藤枯，句歸何處？未審和尚如何指示？師喝一喝，僧禮拜。師乃云：雪峯領眾到浮江寄夏，自失一隻眼；西院留天平商量兩錯，不惜幾莖眉；雲峰有年無德，也不留人過夏，商量兩錯，生風起草；也不領徒諸方寄夏，帶水拖泥；也不探龍宮，蹋番巨海；也不入虎穴，踢倒須彌；只是飲水定渴，喫飯療飢。禪客相逢只彈指，此心能有幾人知？上堂。玄沙和尚道：者一片田地分付諸人多少時也？須知者一片田地非七寶之所成就，晝夜常放無量𤥖光，不以日月所照為明，三世諸佛踏不著，六代祖師行不到，明眼衲僧覰不見。現前一眾，二六時中，行住坐臥，折旋俯仰，忽然蹉脚踏著，打箇翻車筋斗，甦醒起來，方知道：元來平似鏡，誰道爛如泥？七月旦行道，上堂。僧問：朝離東土，暮往西天，是什麼人？師云：十字街頭石敢當。進云：昨日有人從天台來，因甚向南岳去？師云：鮎魚上竹竿。進云：有一人常在途中，不離家舍；有一人常在家舍，不離途中。且道孰優孰劣？師云：兔馬有角，牛羊無角。進云：恁麼則庭前一葉落，天下盡知秋。師云：知時別宜，堪作闍黎。僧禮拜。師乃云：三十年來住子胡，二時粥飯氣力麁，無事下山行一轉，借問時人會也無？子胡大似年老心孤。雲峰則不然，三四年來住道場，二時粥飯氣力強，普請下山行一轉，萬頃田疇𥝧稏香。上堂，僧問：達磨面壁，意旨如何？師云：餿飯泥茶爐。進云：六祖踏碓又作麼生？師云：兔子喫牛嬭。進云：一人道不識，一人道不會，意在什麼處？師云：鳳林吒之。僧禮拜。師乃云：達磨不識九年面壁，六祖不會長年踏碓。帶累兒孫，東倒西儡。新婦騎驢阿家牽，張公喫酒李公醉。好大哥！上堂：一二三四五六七，地水火風空覺識。一

Occurrences.Kwic: 躬膺末命，中興祖山，三十五年，大其獅吼，櫛風沐雨，蒞眾勤勞，卒為宗門砥柱，克紹宏模，功勳蓋代，洵法門之盛事也。當是時，海內崇其道化，如汾州雙髻，儼然再來。嗟乎，先世之建立光明如此，而為之後者不能繼武承勝，接其標流，豈不令披燈續史之賢，瞻妙高而詠歎哉？吼和尚以分座宿將，起而嗣之，二十餘年，不言之教，電激風馳；不令之機，山行水立。至若奪五宗之旗鼓，剖差別之門庭，開開闔闔、變變化化，如天之象緯、人之絲綸，雖本於家法，神而明之，皆不出吾和尚掌握中。所謂先後同揆，古今一轍，不其然乎？聞和尚在天目時，截甕為鐺，燃膏代獨，苦參力究，方得了一大事因緣。既而出世武林大覺禪寺，寺為密菴傑祖開山之地，重披荊莽，提唱宗風。靈隱老和尚歎為猶子之賢，而遣使齎供，并為增置寮舍，其亦有玅喜、天童之遺風歟？嘗攷之燈史，古來尊宿名重王侯者，代不乏人，而修齡宿福，未必能兼。和尚得五百餘甲子，去趙州之年不遠，其主祖山，恒滿萬指，福與齒俱隆。及其晚年，會聖駕南巡駐驆，優崇曠典，近古未有。蓋其一生，沖懷恬澹，耆艾康強，儀式型祖宗之德，激揚開後學之蒙，故一語一言，取法從上。讀是錄者，須向筆墨未形、齒縫未開會得，早落第二。若止以父母所生之眼，尋行逐句，豈和尚說法之意哉？萬峰同戒錄序萬峰同戒錄序禪宗律學，佛祖慧命所在。方今法道下衰、人根卑弱，擔荷如來心印者，可不並勵焉？

Occurrences.Kwic: 云：張公喫酒李公醉。便禮拜，川與一蹋。自此機感相投，造詣日深，時十九歲。明年復回國清，擬寒山詩三百首，故後有送僧歸天台，有休居平生懶開口，咄咄擬題三百首。正音決定有誰知，古也不先今不後之句。逮橫川赴詔住育王，即專永藏主速師至。未幾，歸擇木寮，久參碩德，已立下風。時川會下有寶其名者，尤為頴出，故川每曰：唯寶、茂二師能知老僧舌頭落處。依育王六載，再往姑蘇省啟禪師。道由錢塘，徑山雲峰高禪師延之度夏，所有名衲悉浞之遊，且求師判雲門。室中垂示及諸因緣，隨扣隨應，座客愕然。秋至平江，靈巖啟禪師留掌藏鑰。續於承天歸蒙堂，尤為虎嚴伏和尚推重畏敬，力輓分座。後出世天平白雲禪寺，為此菴之嗣。居九載，遷開元，叢席尤盛。或云：自古才高謗起，法盛魔生，未可為福。幾半載，果有不意之橈，謝去虎丘。東洲永禪師闢室於隆祖塔院以延之，互為主伴，應接無方，故有休居來雲巖，偈債有千萬。年頭至年尾，迅筆寧不辦之句。時有宣、莒二藏主服勤左右，洎請益雪竇拈古，每舉次，必著語于后，宣集之，行于世。未幾，奉旨重鎮開元，道光益熾。明年冬，楊國公俺普以師道聞于朝，仁廟賜號扶宗普覺佛性禪師，特加護持。內參伯長袁公，居翰林，以偈寄師云：玉几峰頭第一枝，老禪吃吃我深知。曾將鐵杵敲氷骨，自恠鈆刀割蜜脾。法外無心猶涉解，句中有眼即成疑。袈裟不展蒲團穩，此是開元妙總持。又

Occurrences.Kwic: 霧。使道體淺薄，徒墮聲聞，牙瀋口腥，陳因相續，庭檜何香？西來何意？此燈不傳久矣。至若德契勝蘭，聲追安遠，探鷲峰之秘旨，襲龍樹之芳猷，意珠其性月同明，戒香與覺花齊馥，固已機鋒如箭，抑且義學如淵，則予于密藏禪師有深慕焉。乃時遷世遠，法語沉湮，厥五世孫按指穎公，欲紹刻藏之願，蒐搆遺編，竟得于耆舊之手，而手澤箋疏，復出之荒院之間。雖禪師之慧覺長存乎，亦穎公之善述也。予友丹山吳山人為穎公倡，以壽之梓，索弁于予。予讀之，見其或矢願于度生，或銳志于弘法，或踵會元而直入，或精彼岸而誕登，或慷慨于家國天下之間，或預識夫成敗興亡之際，其克肩鴻鉅，露之于重刻方冊大藏及興復楞嚴禪寺，乃終蕭然絕塵蟬蛻世羈之外。何也？要知海水非音，鬥蛇非字，池艸奚關，詩句江峰，寧涉禪心。然解者得之，則陋彼槿榮，珍斯天性。故祖家欲燒故紙，文家欲空萬卷，軫雖殊，道則一也。所以涼雲杳壑，津寄惟深，琅函寶疊，總成活句。讀是編，抑深予秋水伊人之思矣！霜氣肅林，月光透紙，予將參密師于蕭疏菊影間，密師其許我否？戊戌季秋，止庵居士王祺題於溪上之松浮舫。刻大藏願文一短述刻大藏願文手卷存之徑山，另錄此筴留吳江周季華居士處，俟藏事告成，附刻藏緣起後。願力深廣，定有繼起肩荷者，無慮其不克終也。道開謹書為左券，本師和尚同開之、仲淳兩居士證明。中衍書凡世間創一物，建一事，垂一語

Occurrences.Kwic: 帥褒封明覺禪師錫之勅印感荷恩洪古佛來世紹隆法化除其望闕謝恩之外惟以朝夕頂焚祝延聖躬萬壽永繼義農日月恒扇湯禹仁風則天下朝宗樂業焉不勝惶悚待命之至。進五燈表進五燈表奏為請欽定正宗釋典俞旨入藏頒行以彰禪德以揚法化事竊以朝廷之治必用禮樂正教為經而佛祖之道亦藉語言文字以顯故政者致治之本而文者載道之器人臻於道國臻於治相須而成相助為理自古及今未之或廢者也草野微賤遭逢聖明仁慈廣博三寶聿隆德化蕩平四隅歸嚮真所稱佛心天子有道聖人何幸荷承隆遇萬善殿得覲龍光延壽寺瀳蒙鴻澤勅印賜號有加無已說法開戒至再至三聖德如天念㳙涘之莫報皇恩若鑑敬蒭蕘以前陳竊有進焉師祖現住浙江嘉興府石門縣福嚴禪寺通容者達磨四十一世之嫡裔臨濟三十一代之正傳也生長八閩受臘六十有七歷居十剎闡法二十餘年德業過人道風秀世所慮法門凋敝釋典混淆於辛卯年編輯五燈嚴統一書類遵宋普濟禪師五燈會元舊本列宋元明大清近代禪宗其中一二傳疑悉依大藏佛祖通載兼傳世諸書旁搜確證言言根據訂定無誤凡二十五卷蓋此書之名嚴統者緣佛祖傳流既遠時代浸遙五代緒分千燈續熖未免宗支混濫法譜誵訛立說唱教者乃似是而或非後學叅求者遂傳虛而失實師祖所以痛心扼腕不憚艱劬勒成此書詳覈考正字字無謬十年心血兩眼冰霜天地鬼神實式臨之釋典之有嚴統亦猶儒教之有正史關繫世道人心者匪淺以鮮正宜為世模範典型百代會事機不偶湮沒名山原本已恭呈睿

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 云：張公喫酒李公醉。便禮拜，川與一蹋。自此機感相投，造詣日深，時十九歲。明年復回國清，擬寒山詩三百首，故後有送僧歸天台，有休居平生懶開口，咄咄擬題三百首。正音決定有誰知，古也不先今不後之句。逮橫川赴詔住育王，即專永藏主速師至。未幾，歸擇木寮，久參碩德，已立下風。時川會下有寶其名者，尤為頴出，故川每曰：唯寶、茂二師能知老僧舌頭落處。依育王六載，再往姑蘇省啟禪師。道由錢塘，徑山雲峰高禪師延之度夏，所有名衲悉浞之遊，且求師判雲門。室中垂示及諸因緣，隨扣隨應，座客愕然。秋至平江，靈巖啟禪師留掌藏鑰。續於承天歸蒙堂，尤為虎嚴伏和尚推重畏敬，力輓分座。後出世天平白雲禪寺，為此菴之嗣。居九載，遷開元，叢席尤盛。或云：自古才高謗起，法盛魔生，未可為福。幾半載，果有不意之橈，謝去虎丘。東洲永禪師闢室於隆祖塔院以延之，互為主伴，應接無方，故有休居來雲巖，偈債有千萬。年頭至年尾，迅筆寧不辦之句。時有宣、莒二藏主服勤左右，洎請益雪竇拈古，每舉次，必著語于后，宣集之，行于世。未幾，奉旨重鎮開元，道光益熾。明年冬，楊國公俺普以師道聞于朝，仁廟賜號扶宗普覺佛性禪師，特加護持。內參伯長袁公，居翰林，以偈寄師云：玉几峰頭第一枝，老禪吃吃我深知。曾將鐵杵敲氷骨，自恠鈆刀割蜜脾。法外無心猶涉解，句中有眼即成疑。袈裟不展蒲團穩，此是開元妙總持。又

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 霧。使道體淺薄，徒墮聲聞，牙瀋口腥，陳因相續，庭檜何香？西來何意？此燈不傳久矣。至若德契勝蘭，聲追安遠，探鷲峰之秘旨，襲龍樹之芳猷，意珠其性月同明，戒香與覺花齊馥，固已機鋒如箭，抑且義學如淵，則予于密藏禪師有深慕焉。乃時遷世遠，法語沉湮，厥五世孫按指穎公，欲紹刻藏之願，蒐搆遺編，竟得于耆舊之手，而手澤箋疏，復出之荒院之間。雖禪師之慧覺長存乎，亦穎公之善述也。予友丹山吳山人為穎公倡，以壽之梓，索弁于予。予讀之，見其或矢願于度生，或銳志于弘法，或踵會元而直入，或精彼岸而誕登，或慷慨于家國天下之間，或預識夫成敗興亡之際，其克肩鴻鉅，露之于重刻方冊大藏及興復楞嚴禪寺，乃終蕭然絕塵蟬蛻世羈之外。何也？要知海水非音，鬥蛇非字，池艸奚關，詩句江峰，寧涉禪心。然解者得之，則陋彼槿榮，珍斯天性。故祖家欲燒故紙，文家欲空萬卷，軫雖殊，道則一也。所以涼雲杳壑，津寄惟深，琅函寶疊，總成活句。讀是編，抑深予秋水伊人之思矣！霜氣肅林，月光透紙，予將參密師于蕭疏菊影間，密師其許我否？戊戌季秋，止庵居士王祺題於溪上之松浮舫。刻大藏願文一短述刻大藏願文手卷存之徑山，另錄此筴留吳江周季華居士處，俟藏事告成，附刻藏緣起後。願力深廣，定有繼起肩荷者，無慮其不克終也。道開謹書為左券，本師和尚同開之、仲淳兩居士證明。中衍書凡世間創一物，建一事，垂一語

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 帥褒封明覺禪師錫之勅印感荷恩洪古佛來世紹隆法化除其望闕謝恩之外惟以朝夕頂焚祝延聖躬萬壽永繼義農日月恒扇湯禹仁風則天下朝宗樂業焉不勝惶悚待命之至。進五燈表進五燈表奏為請欽定正宗釋典俞旨入藏頒行以彰禪德以揚法化事竊以朝廷之治必用禮樂正教為經而佛祖之道亦藉語言文字以顯故政者致治之本而文者載道之器人臻於道國臻於治相須而成相助為理自古及今未之或廢者也草野微賤遭逢聖明仁慈廣博三寶聿隆德化蕩平四隅歸嚮真所稱佛心天子有道聖人何幸荷承隆遇萬善殿得覲龍光延壽寺瀳蒙鴻澤勅印賜號有加無已說法開戒至再至三聖德如天念㳙涘之莫報皇恩若鑑敬蒭蕘以前陳竊有進焉師祖現住浙江嘉興府石門縣福嚴禪寺通容者達磨四十一世之嫡裔臨濟三十一代之正傳也生長八閩受臘六十有七歷居十剎闡法二十餘年德業過人道風秀世所慮法門凋敝釋典混淆於辛卯年編輯五燈嚴統一書類遵宋普濟禪師五燈會元舊本列宋元明大清近代禪宗其中一二傳疑悉依大藏佛祖通載兼傳世諸書旁搜確證言言根據訂定無誤凡二十五卷蓋此書之名嚴統者緣佛祖傳流既遠時代浸遙五代緒分千燈續熖未免宗支混濫法譜誵訛立說唱教者乃似是而或非後學叅求者遂傳虛而失實師祖所以痛心扼腕不憚艱劬勒成此書詳覈考正字字無謬十年心血兩眼冰霜天地鬼神實式臨之釋典之有嚴統亦猶儒教之有正史關繫世道人心者匪淺以鮮正宜為世模範典型百代會事機不偶湮沒名山原本已恭呈睿

Senses.Explanation: 禪寺 means a 'Chan monastery': an institution explicitly named as Chan. The records use it in career biography, succession history, restoration documentation, and an official residence statement. These uses establish institutional identity and place; they do not, without further evidence, define how every such monastery was organized.

Senses.Explanation: A Chan couch is the couch or raised seat around which a Chan encounter is staged. A record of Zhaozhou tells how he did not get down from the couch when the king arrived; Dahui Pujue records a tap on it before leaving the seat; and a lamp account has Mayu circle it before speaking. The term is concrete furniture in the scene, often made meaningful by the action at it, not a name for an abstract practice.

Senses.Note: Chan worthy names a respected participant in the Chan community, most often in the plural vocative the assembled Chan worthies and sometimes with particular people named.

Senses.Explanation: The 禪牀 is the raised teaching seat at the center of a public encounter. Niutou Huizhong strikes it when asked to reveal his disciples, and three tigers emerge roaring. Danxia Tianran circles Nanyang Huizhong's seat before leaving; Deng Yinfeng likewise circles Shitou Xiqian's seat, shakes his staff, and demands the principle. Xuedou Chongxian can even propose overturning it in comment on Yunmen. Later hall records show Shishuang Chuyuan, Baoning Jueyin Ziying, and Dahui Zonggao striking the seat as part of an address. These cases identify its Zen job through observable public action: it is the master's teaching seat, not evidence for a private sitting regimen.

Senses.Explanation: A Chan sickness is not an illness belonging to Chan itself but a diagnosed error in how people investigate, certify, imitate, teach, or seek recognition; Dahui states that distinction explicitly and later masters keep applying it publicly. Dahui Zonggao says Chan has no headache, leg pain, deafness, or dim sight: the sickness lies in practitioners' differences of investigation, certification, effort, and dependence on teachers. Yunwai Xingze quotes that diagnosis while addressing requests to expose contemporary faults. Hanyue Fazang's letter praises Dahui for exhausting the human sicknesses of Chan, and the receiving master punctuates the reading with shouts. Yingning Jing identifies cleverness, accumulated explanation, and imitation among contemporary illnesses; Tianran Hanshi attacks the pursuit of reputation by teachers and students.

Senses.Note: One productive person-label: 者 denotes a person characterized by studying, practicing, claiming, or teaching Chan. Those contextual roles do not prove separate lexical senses. The non-person construction 故禪者, 'as for Chan,' is excluded.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 疋馬單刀句？」師驀面一掌，便歸方丈。示眾，云：「老僧欲睡，侍者舉今日為大眾入室因緣，老僧復為大眾頌出：兩堂雲水求入室，一碗殘茶當面擲，逐塊韓盧腳底忙，尿床鬼子胸頭急。對賓不涉有無機，覿面相呈殺活句，非但山僧獨恁麼，大都佛祖亦如是。」示眾，云：「者箇事相從者百，不如信向者一二；信向者百，不如徹證者一二；徹證者百，不如當此惡世行道者一二。然而行道者雖得一二，及乎究竟諦當處尚未及古人履歷。近代且無上古叢林、上古師法、上古機會，吾儕入蜀經今十載，雖叢林禮法不如上古，風俗漸移，稍通一線與人信、與人行，但久近之間不恒篤信此道，大約自辜本心，立志不善，往往詐明頭我是參禪者、我是學道者，把句古人語蘊在胸中，謂是本參話頭，及至登門歷戶，有語無語盡逐落華流水，拋擲腦後。故終身而無成者，其病在心志之不善，非禪道之不靈也。若是一定有話頭與人參、有實法與人會，則達磨初祖不知擔幾許話頭來，迄今也是有盡。山僧每對學人言遇境生疑、逢緣理會，甚是捷當、甚是至要，胡不聞酒樓和尚聞客人唱曲，云：『你若無心我便休。』忽然大悟？遠公社十八高賢內有一高賢棄妻出家，夜夢與原妻行不淨行，自揣彼又不曾來、我又不曾去，因何而有此事？致疑，不待天明忽然大豁。此從上先德如此悟證，難道定是參話頭、做工夫得耶？凡是遇境逢緣處即是觸發，忽一觸發便是大疑，有大疑必有大悟
ClaimAnchors.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan (破山禪師語錄): Poshan criticizes people who merely claim, 'I am a Chan practitioner; I am a student of the Way.'

Senses.Explanation: 禪者 is a person-label for someone characterized by Chan practice. Its modifiers specify the role: 參禪者 is a student who investigates Chan, 習禪者 one who cultivates it, and 說禪者 one who expounds it. Poshan also quotes the self-description 'I am a Chan practitioner' while criticizing empty claims to that identity. Student, practitioner, claimant, and teacher are contextual roles within one productive nominal construction, not separate dictionary senses.

Senses.Explanation: A Chan monastery is the named residential institution in which an abbot presides and a recorded teaching career is located. Lamp colophons identify Puming and Huirì Yunwen through the Chan monasteries where they serve as abbots. Transmission rosters attach named lineage figures to Baoing Chan Monastery, while collected-record contents organize successive bodies of sayings by Ciyun, Lianfeng, and Shousheng Chan Monasteries. A preface treats restoring Zhaojue Chan Monastery from overgrown ground as a major institutional act. The Chan bend is documentary and public: the monastery is not generic scenery but the named seat that locates a lineage figure, an abbacy, a body of sayings, and the restoration or transmission of the lineage.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB183.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shiqi of Xuedou. Shiqi Tongyun opens an address by saying that Chan is not conceptual imagining and the way is beyond achievements. As soon as one starts asking how it is to be managed, he says, one is thousands of miles away. He therefore claims to have no Chan for people to investigate and no way for them to learn, only plain, rustic work growing food to eat. Yet he still sweeps his whisk and asks whether they understand, ending with idle fields before and behind the mountain that must be turned over completely. The pair checks a project of mentally constructing or accumulating attainment; its agricultural activity and renewed challenge keep it from being a blanket recommendation to stop practicing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 乃云：「禪非意想，道絕功勳，棒喝機鋒，全提正令。切莫見存人我，毀謗法門；切莫情墮斷常，乖違法體。去去實不去，黃山萬疊峰巒秀；來來實不來，石耳千重山嶽朝。且開天闢地，建立法幢，報國祐民，舉揚宗旨一句作麼生道？大家齊出手，復建最初功。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB300.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chaozong. At his installation at Shier Mountain, Chaozong Tongren says that countless teachings arise from his raised whisk, then lowers it and warns against viewing it that way. He follows with the pair denying imagining and achievement, but immediately affirms blows, shouts and the full exercise of teaching authority. He warns against fixed self-and-other views and against falling into annihilation or permanence, before calling for everyone to lend a hand in establishing the teaching. The headword limits how teaching is grasped, not whether responsive teaching and common work occur. His closing call to renew the original work gives the negation a concrete institutional setting.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J36/J36nB364.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Foguwen. Fogu Xingwen follows the pair with Xiangyan's awakening at the sound of struck bamboo and Lingyun's encounter with peach blossoms. Understanding and doubts fall away, while his images move from a pork stall and flies on a wounded donkey to wind over brocade and a moon reflected in spring water. A staff strike concludes that if this is understood here, high mountains and level ground are all the western land. The headword introduces direct recognition through encounters rather than an achievement manufactured by thought. The surprising images are not all decoded, and the closing claim should not be flattened into a geographical statement or a promise that passive exposure to sights and sounds is enough.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB383.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hanxiu. After answering questions about what is beyond and the final opening with an iron ox swallowing a mountain and a wooden woman giving birth, Hanxiu Ruqian says Chan is not imagining and the way is beyond achievements. Stirring thought misses it, and treating it as cultivation and certification is mistaken; even immediate clarity remains an image like a rabbit's pregnancy or a pearl-bearing shell. He then calls for actual enactment in which mountains, water, monks and laypeople are each themselves without opposition. Asked within his address for a sentence before such distinctions, he answers with impossible blossoms in fire and stone shoots in clouds. His progression denies the appropriation of attainment while retaining the demand for lived practice, rather than endorsing mere inaction.

Senses.PreferredTarget: The one who is close does not ask; the one who asks is not close
AlternateTargets: Whoever is intimate does not ask, and whoever asks is not intimate
SearchAliases: the close one does not ask the asker is not close
Senses.Note: Ding and Jiashan disagree about whether there is a Buddha within birth and death. Damei says one view is close and one distant, then refuses to name which: “The one who is close does not ask; the one who asks is not close.” The answer turns their demand for a ranking back on the act of asking. Juelang, Shiqi, Duanqiao, and Gulin each revisit the old exchange, while Daxiu gives the pair as his own answer to a new question about seeing and acting. Here “close” means meeting the point firsthand, not family or physical proximity.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 拈的、口裡道的，畢竟從甚麼處得來？」答：「拂子頭邊。」頌：昨夜泥牛翻海底，今朝木馬吼春風，須彌撥轉青霄外，大地收來掌握中。問：心明能超曠劫，英雄力破重圍，為甚麼道秪為分明極，番令所得遲？答：「太平原是將軍致，不許將軍見太平。」頌：百戰場中得自由，將軍韜略掌中籌，揮開日面驅雷電，萬里關山暗點頭。問：「如是我聞，與乾屎橛是同是別？」答：「冬瓜直儱侗，瓠子曲灣灣。」頌：犀牛驀地翻身轉，踏破煙霞幾萬重，滿目春光留不住，海門迸出一輪紅。問：「東家作驢，西家作馬，要騎便騎，要下便下。且道此人得何三昧？」答：「腰纏十萬貫，騎鶴上楊州。」頌：金毛擺尾出雲峰，搖落桃花遍地紅，踏破珊瑚枝上月，木人起舞笑春風。問：「夜深不向蘆灣泊，迥脫中間與兩頭，且道此人如何行履？」答：「風力扶帆行不棹，笛聲邀月下滄洲。」頌：梁主追尋過別峰，流傳千古與誰通？秋江暗渡無人識，不住蘆花兩岸中。問：「在眼曰見，在耳曰聞，在手曰捉，在足曰奔。便恁麼承當，還有過也無？」答：「親者不問，問者不親。」頌：一葉扁舟江上遊，十分春色許誰收？獰龍迅轉千層浪，曾把須彌作繡毬。問：「高峰四句內有一句能縱能奪、能殺能活，且道是那一句？」答：「問處甚分明。」頌：芒鞋踏破鐵城東，聊借烏藤下別峰，格外乾坤都掃蕩，輕輕拈向缽盂中。問：「趙州東壁挂葫蘆，意旨如何？」答：「無意旨。」頌：一毫頭上露天機，凡聖由來總不知，輕輕撥轉關捩子，枯木花開劫外枝。問：「此眾無枝葉，惟有諸真實，作麼生說個真實底道理？」答：「人人腳跟點地。」頌：八面玲瓏遶翠微，通身毛羽利如錐，谿山怪石都穿過，脫殼烏龜也解飛。問：「摘葉尋枝則不問，直截根源事若何？」答：「曲了也。」頌：長空迸出一輪秋，萬國驪龍捧玉毬，拍碎寒光飛遍地，還他作者始能收。問：「殺父殺母，向佛前懺悔。殺佛殺祖，向甚處懺悔？」答：「燈籠露柱。」頌：怪石叢中白象王，六牙纔現紫雲彰，玉蹄踏轉千溪月，撲落寒梅遍地香。問：「無舌人解語、無手人行拳，無手人打無舌人，無舌人說個甚麼？」答：「逢人但恁麼問。」頌：四十年來懶坐禪，常將古佛枕頭眠，睡中無甚真消息，鎮夜齁齁大打鼾。問：「普慧雲興二百問，普賢瓶瀉二千酬。且道問底答底從甚麼處來？」答：「隨聲便喝。」頌：紫氣騰騰山色奇，靈峰怪石露天機，三間茅屋從來住，一滴曹溪遶

Senses.Explanation: Damei refuses to rank two views and instead points to what their question reveals. Juelang and Shiqi reopen the dispute over whether Jiashan lost or gained an eye after hearing Damei. Daxiu makes the line a new answer; Duanqiao and Gulin each test the old exchange from another angle.

Senses.Explanation: To see firsthand is to witness something directly or meet someone in person. An unnamed questioning monk says he has personally seen the abbot; other retained passages use the phrase for meeting a predecessor, asking whether Pindola himself saw the Buddha, and being permitted to meet Ciming. The term marks direct personal access rather than information received only by report.

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「者老漢話墮也。」師云：「親言出親口。」峰便喝，師云：「學來底一般。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin. Feiyin Tongrong returns the phrase when Feng declares that the old man has fallen into words.

Senses.Explanation: One’s own words from one’s own mouth marks a statement as that same person’s direct, firsthand saying. In Chan interviews it is itself returned as an answer or as a compact certification of what the other person has just said. Miyun gives it as the whole answer to two different questions; Feiyin applies it first to a layman’s conclusion and then to Feng’s charge that Feiyin has fallen into words.

Senses.Explanation: Speak what cannot be enacted; enact what cannot be spoken. Dongshan's paired reversal tests whether speaking and doing can be reduced to each other. Selected current source uses: Liangting Jingting in J33nB294, Xieyun Jiji in J34nB303, Gumei Dinglie in J39nB463, Yun'e Xi in J28nB203. The complete wording is the entry unit. The current sources expound the inherited line; they do not claim to be Dongshan.

Senses.Explanation: ‘Ten feet of talk are worth less than one foot of action’ puts lived conduct ahead of impressive explanation. Masters use the unequal measures to ask whether a listener's words have become a step taken in the world. Tian'an Sheng asks whether the assembly has actually entered the gate after giving the proverb. Yuanjie Jingying brings it into a rebuke of people whose fluent teaching conceals destructive conduct. In an authored training discourse, Huishan Jiexian insists that clear understanding and conduct mature together, then invokes the proverb to weight the student's subsequent acts. Yuanwu Keqin's authored instruction warns that old phrases alone need not all be mastered; the work is to keep insight present when events arrive. Xuzhou Pudu extends the measure once more: even walking a foot must give way to another release. Yongjue Yuanxian says speaking is easier than acting, but a person proud of both is still caught in self and other.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB309.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunfu Zhi. Yunfu Daozhi owns the retained deployment: speaking mind and nature — snowflakes on the red furnace; citing old and present — grit in the eye; a pig-iron patchrobe will not keep to the ruts.

Senses.Explanation: Speaking mind, speaking nature: the explanatory talk the masters refuse — evil mouth, boot-scratching, snow on the red furnace. Dongshan Liangjie, walking with his senior fellow, points at a roadside cloister: inside there is someone speaking mind and speaking nature — who? says the uncle, and Dongshan dies ten-tenths dead; who is the speaker? — alive out of death; Wuzu Fayan's ruling survives in Dahui Zonggao's armory: the three disciples found the old man too dry to speak it and asked him about the buddha-body beyond all counts; he gave them the mani-pearl mirrored in the five colors, they marveled that he finished in a line or two — a real old tiger — and when he heard their praise he ruled: to speak mind and speak nature is evil mouth; the cat has its blood-oath, the tiger its corpse-raising; you drive the plowman's ox and snatch the starving man's food, or you are mud-pie men; Yuanwu Keqin lists the stage-gestures of the imitators — drawing a circle, three steps forward and back, a woman's bow, a slap and a shout, knitted brows, or speaking mind and speaking nature — all of it just mood-dust and habit-mind, the knower mistaken for the one who was never born; Dahui Zonggao, in the general discourse, sets the gate: to seek mystery and marvel, to speak mind and speak nature, reason and fact, wanting to enter this gate — like pummelling an itch with a fist through a boot, and happily nothing to do with it. Zhongfeng Mingben diagnoses its hearers: all day long like an unliberated ghost — the moment they see someone speak mind and speak nature they prop themselves along fences and walls to shore up against it, and when a paw is suddenly bared they swallow the date whole; Shitian Faxun pairs it against the citing of old cases: citing old and present is kneading mud into water, speaking mind and speaking nature paints a tiger and gets a wildcat — a thousand men pushing at the gate is not worth one man drawing the bolt; Yuan'an Liao strips his own work to it: at best it is carving sores in good flesh and riveting a handle on the almsbowl — speaking mind and speaking nature is the traitor of a peaceful age, stick and shout are the heroes of a lawless one; Yunfu Daozhi melts it in two strokes: speaking mind and speaking nature — snowflakes on the red furnace; citing old and present — grit in the eye; a patchrobe cast of pig-iron will not keep to the ruts.

Senses.Explanation: To present the teaching means to set teaching out in speech. Yongming Yanshou refers to what has already been presented while discussing the scale of written teaching. When an unnamed monk asks Tianyi Yihuai to present the teaching, he answers that among the trees birds cry and beneath the water fish walk. The noun-like 'what has been presented' and the request 'please present the teaching' are two grammatical forms of the same act.

SearchAliases: talk of food cannot satisfy hunger
Senses.Explanation: Talking about food names verbal description that does not itself feed anyone, though one snow-day address treats such talk as fitting for that occasion. Huitang Zuxin, Guaishi Qi, Chaozong Tongren, Zhongfeng Mingben, and Tian’an Sheng use the explicit comparison between food-talk and hunger: the words do not provide the meal or fullness they describe. Baichi Xingyuan then quotes Yuantong Faxiu’s three snowbound monks and says that the one talking about food by the stove is the most fitting at that time, because the food wheel turns before the teaching wheel. The activity remains talking about food, but Baichi’s appraisal prevents treating the expression as an automatic rebuke in every setting.

Entries.SourceTerm: 貪他一粒米，失卻半年糧

Senses.PreferredTarget: Gain one grain of rice, lose half a year’s food
AlternateTargets: A grain gained can cost half a year’s provisions
SearchAliases: one grain of rice half a year of food
Senses.Note: The saying warns that clutching at a small immediate benefit can forfeit something much larger. Chan teachers use that contrast to test whether a student is bargaining for an answer, reward, or spiritual gain.

Senses.Explanation: Gain one grain of rice, lose half a year’s food warns that a small prize can cost a far greater good. Baiyu warns that pursuing Buddha, subtlety, or even the appearance of not being misled can itself be a trap. Suru gives the proverb as his answer to a question about abandoning the root for a branch. Wuqu applies it to treating an immense scriptural claim as a prize to win. Yinyuan says it to a visitor whose hospitality has detained him. Fogu uses the warning when asked what teaching a feast will buy. Yikui applies it in his own comment on an older encounter. Huiyue places it amid the claim that present practitioners can miss what is already before them.

Senses.Explanation: Xutang answers an unnamed questioner’s accumulated string of challenges with a food verdict: greed for too much leaves the chewing coarse. The unnamed questioner moves through several inherited phrases and finally equates the former Songyuan with the present abbot. Xutang Zhiyu answers, “Remember it well,” after diagnosing this questioner as greedy for much and unable to chew it fine.

Senses.Explanation: Greed, anger, and delusion are the three afflictive poisons named in Chan instruction. Yuanan and Guxue warn against following them, Poshan counsels a lay practitioner not to be misled by them, and Lianyue turns the phrase toward a direct seeing of their relation to wisdom. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

SearchAliases: miss the oar in your hand
Senses.Note: A boatman who stares at the moon and loses the oar has traded the means to move for a distant spectacle. Chan masters use the saying to challenge fixation on elevated images, clever cases, or a supposed attainment while overlooking what is needed now.

Senses.Explanation: Gazing greedily at the moon above, you lose the oar in your hand warns that a compelling distant sight can make one lose the means immediately needed. Shiyu gives the line to a question about who would receive the transmission if an entire audience smiled. Faxi Yin applies it to inherited talk about pointing at and playing with the moon. Chaozong uses it for someone who seeks an exit from birth and death before a decisive breakthrough. Xiangya says the masters of famous cases still fall short of the higher matter when watched this way. Yikui applies the warning to a demon who misses the monk he pursues. Lingji gives it after criticizing an old account of the Buddha’s final teaching.

Senses.Explanation: Deviant understanding is a verdict delivered on an interpretation, claimed realization, or encounter response judged to have gone crooked. Wuyi Yuanlai applies it to guarding a bright knowing subject and mistaking it for mastery. A transmission biography says Dahui Zonggao publicly exposed its subject’s cherished understanding as deviant, forcing him to re-enter as a student. Dahui also says that beyond a handful of showy responses to his bamboo-slip test, the remaining deviant interpretations are innumerable. The term classifies an understanding in public adjudication; it does not mean moral evil in general.
